cues: A padded saddle rests above the rear wheel, adjustable to suit different riders’ leg lengths.
Multiple gears alter resistance, helping riders climb steep hills or maintain speed on level pavement.
A metal stand folds down beside the rear wheel to keep the parked machine upright.
Curved metal fenders shield clothing from spray thrown upward by wet rotating tires.
A rear cargo rack provides a platform for panniers, baskets, or strapped-down parcels.
A small bell near the grip rings sharply to alert pedestrians along shared paths.
